scenes.headline: How SurfSLAM maps shipwrecks with sound and stereo
scenes.sub: A DVL-driven factor graph, and stereo taught that open water is empty
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Hibiscus! Here's how SurfSLAM maps shipwrecks, with sound doing the tracking and stereo fixing the drift.

scenes.text: Let a velocity sonar and inertial sensors carry the tracking, and use learned stereo only to pull drift back at revisits.
scenes.say: Sonar and inertial sensors do the tracking. Stereo only pulls the drift back when the robot sees a place again.

scenes.title: Teaching stereo about water
scenes.say: The stereo network learns in stages.

items.say: Render wrecks in simulation, where depth is known.
Add haze, caustics, lamps and particles, fresh every time.
Fine-tune on real footage without labels, by warping one image onto the other.
And prefer zero disparity unless something clearly beats it, so open water stays empty.

steps.say: Inertial readings, DVL velocities and barometer depth stream in.
They become factors in one graph, solved incrementally once a second.
When the robot sees an old place, stereo depth aligns the two views.
That enters the graph as a loop closure, and the corrected poses place every depth map.
On real footage, the fine-tuned model leaves open water black: nothing there.
Models trained in air fill the same water with phantom surfaces.

scenes.title: Trajectory error on the Long survey, metres
scenes.say: On the longest survey, SurfSLAM ends under half a metre off. Without the camera, one point three metres.

scenes.label: error on the Long survey with the DVL switched off
scenes.say: Switch the DVL off, and the same run ends four hundred and fifty metres off.

scenes.text: The DVL carries the tracking; stereo only needs to be right when it speaks, and silent about open water.
scenes.say: Sonar carries the tracking. Stereo only has to be right when it speaks, and quiet about open water.

recap: Sound and inertia track in one factor graph
Stereo learns water from simulation, then real footage
Registrations at revisits pull the drift back
scenes.say: To recap: sound tracks, stereo learns that water is empty, and revisits pull the drift back.
